subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: What should Anthropic QuickStart do before first terminal chat when the selected default is an Opus paid-credit model?
rationale: The source path is clear, but choosing between safer defaults, explicit confirmation, billing preflight, or documented intentional behavior is a product/defaults decision with provider-cost implications.

options.title: Warn and offer a safe change before hatch
options.body: Add a paid-credit warning/preflight for Anthropic Opus before terminal hatch and give the user a clear change-model or provider-fix path.

options.title: Change the default model policy
options.body: Switch first-run Anthropic setup to a lower-cost/default model and keep Opus as an explicit advanced selection.

options.title: Document current behavior as intentional
options.body: Keep Opus as the default, but document the cost requirement and improve first-chat billing failure copy so setup is not mistaken for a broken install.

recommendation.title: Warn and offer a safe change before hatch
recommendation.body: Add a paid-credit warning/preflight for Anthropic Opus before terminal hatch and give the user a clear change-model or provider-fix path.

likelyOwner.reason: The Anthropic default and current setup rewrites trace most directly to this owner history, and the decision is about product defaults.
